status: Exploratory reuse of previously examined data; no independent confirmation or significance claim. Known noise variance. No candidate changes or test-dependent tuning.
formula: D=OOF risk matrix - mean fold training SURE matrix. Linear corrected objective = full SURE(w) + diag(D)^T w. Full matrix correction is assessed only at fixed weights, not optimized.
limitations: Fold-size gap need not transfer to full sample. Linear correction is exact at vertices but omits mixture correction interactions. Fixed-weight SURE does not account for response-adaptive weight divergence.
